intro: Clear the mines and conquer the galaxy!
description:
MineSweeper Galaxy brings the classic mine-clearing puzzle into a colourful space adventure.

Reveal tiles, study the numbered clues, and locate every hidden mine. Each number shows how many mines are hidden in the surrounding spaces. Mark dangerous tiles, uncover all safe areas, and clear the board without triggering a mine.

Start with smaller puzzles and unlock larger, more challenging boards as you progress through the Nova, Supernova, Galaxy, and Universe stages.

Minesweeper is more than a game of chance. Every tile you uncover, mine you mark, and numbered clue you analyse challenges your problem-solving, pattern-recognition, and deductive-reasoning skills.

With simple controls, multiple difficulty levels, and colourful space-themed graphics, MineSweeper Galaxy is suitable for both new players and experienced puzzle fans.

Experience the satisfaction of mastering Minesweeper as you progress from beginner to expert, learn new strategies, and discover smarter ways to clear each board.

Features:
• Multiple board sizes and difficulty levels: Nova (9 × 9), Supernova (15 × 15), Galaxy (80 × 30), and Universe (80 × 80)
• Resume your last game session and continue where you left off
• Use hints whenever you get stuck
• Play in Handheld Mode, Tabletop Mode, or TV Mode
• Pan across the board and zoom in or out
• Colourful space-themed graphics, professional background music, and sound effects
• Compete with players around the world through online leaderboard rankings
